subject: Impasto oil painting of a small fishing harbour at sunset: three or four wooden boats with masts at their moorings, a stone quay with a few houses, an orange and rose sky breaking into cool violet clouds, the water full of broken reflections laid on with a palette knife, thick paint, warm light.

Oil painting still life in the Dutch manner: three lemons, one cut open with its peel curling off the table edge, a blue-and-white porcelain bowl, a pewter knife, on a rumpled linen cloth over a dark wooden table, deep dark background, light from the upper left, rich chiaroscuro, visible brushwork.

Alla prima oil painting of pink and white peonies in a glazed celadon vase, a few fallen petals on the table, soft grey-green background with loose brushwork, daylight from a window on the left, thick creamy highlights on the petals, painterly and fresh.

Oil painting of a city street on a rainy night: glowing shop windows and street lamps in amber and red, wet cobblestones full of long vertical reflections, two or three small figures with umbrellas walking away, deep blue-violet darkness, bold palette-knife strokes, thick bright paint for the lights.

Oil painting of a birch grove in autumn, late afternoon: white trunks with black bands, gold and orange leaves, long violet shadows across a floor of fallen leaves, pale blue sky showing through, the trunks laid on with a palette knife, thick dabs for the leaves.
